The '''2014–15 New Zealand Football Championship''' season (currently known as the ASB Premiership  for sponsorship reasons) was the eleventh season of the NZFC since its establishment in 2004. Nine teams are involved this season, which includes the newly formed [[Wellington Phoenix FC Reserves|Wellington Phoenix reserve team]]. [[Auckland City FC|Auckland City]] and [[Team Wellington]] will represent the ASB Premiership in the [[2014–15 OFC Champions League]] after finishing Champions and Runners-up respectively in the [[2013–14 ASB Premiership|2013–14]] competition.

===Fixtures and results===
The 2014–15 season sees every team play the other both home and away. With the introduction of the Wellington Phoenix Reserves side creating an uneven number of teams, each team has two byes in the regular season. However, due to Auckland City FC's participation in the [[2014 OFC President's Cup]] and the [[2014 FIFA Club World Cup]], several matches and byes have been rescheduled.<ref>{{cite web | title= 2014–15 ASB Premiership Draw | url = http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/fileadmin/user_upload/ASB_Premiership/2014-2015/ASB_Premiership_Draw_2014-15.pdf | access-date = 3 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141008170909/http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/fileadmin/user_upload/ASB_Premiership/2014-2015/ASB_Premiership_Draw_2014-15.pdf|archive-date=8 October 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-fixtures/|title=2014–15 fixtures and results|website=New Zealand Football|access-date=14 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151006101407/http://www.nzfootball.co.nz/asb-premiership-fixtures/|archive-date=6 October 2015|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
